context: Ticket 5530. Customer: Harbor Print, a print shop with an online order form. Contact: Rita Cole, office manager. The order form runs on PHP 8.1 with a mail plugin called MailPost. Server backups run nightly at 02:00. The support plan includes 4 hours per month.

lines.text: Hi Rita, this is Dan from support. I have your ticket open in front of me.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Thanks Dan. Omar is on the line too, he looks after our website part time.
Good. Please walk me through the symptoms on your side.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Order emails reach us twenty or thirty minutes late, and sometimes a customer gets nothing at all.
That points to the mail queue. I will look at the plugin logs while we talk.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: I did not touch the plugin, but the host moved us to a new server last week.
That is useful to know, I will note the move.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Since the move the order form also freezes on the last step and customers press the button twice.
Double clicks can create duplicate orders, so I will check the order table for pairs.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: I found six duplicate orders from Tuesday alone, and two customers were charged twice.
Thank you Omar. Refunds for the two double charges should go out today.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Our busiest week starts on Monday and I cannot have this broken then.
I understand, Monday is the deadline for both of us.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Logs show the mail plugin timing out against the new mail server every few minutes.
Then the fix is likely a setting on the mail server address.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Honestly our last agency said it was fixed and it was not.
I will not close the ticket until we place a test order together.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: My daughter is getting married on Sunday, so I will be slow to answer this weekend.
Congratulations, I hope it goes well.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: I can be reachable on Saturday if you need me.
